environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with node-level containerd runtime. Pod spec includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via 'securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile: profiles/report-server.json' which restricts syscalls to a narrow allowlist. The profile permits read/write/close/fstat/lseek/mmap/mprotect/munmap/brk/rt_sigaction/rt_sigprocmask/clone/futex/epoll_ctl/epoll_wait/accept4/bind/listen/getsockname/getpeername/setsockopt/fcntl/nanosleep/exit_group/arch_prctl/set_tid_address/set_robust_list/prlimit64/getrandom/openat/newfstatat/getdents64 but explicitly DENIES execve/execveat/ptrace/socket/connect/sendto/sendmsg. The openat syscall is permitted (required for file serving) with no path-based filtering at the seccomp layer. Additionally, a GKE Workload Identity binding restricts the pod's service account to 'roles/logging.logWriter' only.

config.network_policy: egress denied except to metadata server and logging endpoint
config.filesystem: /app/data mounted as emptyDir, no host path mounts
